intro: A Grand Adventure marks a turning point for the crisis on Zephras Isle within Skywall. Led by Ayessa Dawnsinger and the Windshapers, it outlines a bold plan to seek salvation for their home by journeying down to the mortal realm of Azeroth.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.
We'll need strong young adventurers like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So now you see? There is a world of knowledge and untapped potential outside of Skywall. This will never stop being our home, but I've come to believe that the path to our salvation lies below. We must travel to Azeroth and gain the power and means to save Zephras Isle. This is the way.
Will you have the courage to join us when the time comes?
